# Israel Ojiefoh

> Public professional portfolio for Israel Ojiefoh, a backend, full-stack, and mobile systems engineer focused on high-concurrency fintech APIs, production-ready mobile apps, distributed microservices, and SaaS platforms.

## Summary

Israel Ojiefoh is a Backend, Full-Stack, and Mobile Systems Engineer. His work covers high-concurrency API architectures, fintech transaction engines, double-entry financial ledgers, idempotent payment/escrow integrations, cross-platform mobile apps (iOS and Android), microservice backends, database optimization (PostgreSQL), distributed caching (Redis), container orchestration (Docker/Kubernetes), SaaS integrations, and production data pipelines.

## Services

- Fintech & Backend Systems Engineering: High-concurrency APIs, asynchronous task queues, double-entry financial ledgers, race-condition safety, and idempotent payment processing.
- Mobile Engineering: Cross-platform iOS and Android apps, EAS deployment, offline state sync, and native app experiences.
- Backend Microservices & Architecture: Secure REST APIs, event-driven services, WebSockets, and performance-tuned PostgreSQL databases.
- Payment & Escrow Integrations: Payment gateways, milestone-based escrow release logic, merchant dashboards, and platform integrations.
- Cloud and DevOps: Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, distributed Redis caching, and deployment automation.
- Data Pipelines & Full-Stack Prototyping: Feature extraction, data engineering, product architecture, API design, and deployed production systems.

## Selected Projects

- [PeerPurse Africa](https://peerpurse.africa/): Digital banking, P2P lending, and embedded finance platform for individuals and SMEs across Africa, with mobile apps on iOS and Android, wallet ledgers, and automated utility bill payments.
- [RendezvousCare](https://www.rendezvouscare.com/): Comprehensive wellness platform with high-volume checkout infrastructure, appointment scheduling, licensed therapy access, commerce, gift cards, and affiliate rewards.
- [Entrant](https://www.myentrant.com/): Country-arrival guidance platform for newcomers, combining visa rules, scam warnings, local systems, navigation, care passage, benefits, community, mentor matching, compliance reminders, and arrival glossaries into one trusted path.
- [ElAura](https://elaura.pxxl.click/): African creator-brand partnership platform featuring backend escrow payment infrastructure, idempotent payout triggers, milestone tracking, influencer discovery, and creator payout operations.
